method: Exact unit-cost Levenshtein distance independently per source page. Collapse every whitespace run to one ASCII space and trim. Preserve case, spelling, digits and punctuation. Words are whitespace-delimited tokens. Denominators are reference counts after normalization. Accuracy = 100 * (1 - edits / reference count); no clipping at zero. DOCX text is read from word/document.xml in paragraph/table order using source-page bookmarks.
